scope: Native Android Shell path for registering an already purchased SIM/eSIM service entitlement
implemented: Device-home returns a boolean capability indicating whether owner-bound claim redemption is enabled; it does not expose issuer configuration.

Shell API v18 and the Broker expose an owner-session-authenticated claim method. The transport accepts only the configured same-origin claim endpoint, a bounded package envelope, and no automatic retry.

The Shell displays the claim form only when the server advertises redemption, disables saved-state persistence for the input, asks the owner to confirm binding to the current Rockstar ID, and clears the package after success.
The existing server signature, expiry, offer/scope, and single-owner purchase checks remain authoritative. Entitlement, carrier activation, and device OS installation remain separate statuses.
